name: patient_has_undergone_biopsy_of_prostate_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone a prostate biopsy in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone a prostate biopsy at any time in the past.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone a prostate biopsy at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone a prostate biopsy.

name: patient_has_undergone_biopsy_of_prostate_inthehistory@@outcome_is_negative
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the outcome of any past prostate biopsy was negative.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone a prostate biopsy in the past and the outcome was negative.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has ever undergone a prostate biopsy in the past and the outcome was not negative.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the outcome of any past prostate biopsy was negative.

name: patient_number_of_prior_negative_prostate_biopsies_value_recorded_history_withunit_count
meaning: Numeric count of prior negative prostate biopsies the patient has had in their history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many prior negative prostate biopsies the patient has had.
when_value: Set to the number of prior negative prostate biopsies the patient has had in their history, as recorded in the medical record.

name: prostate_specific_antigen_value_latest_withunit_nanograms_per_milliliter
meaning: Numeric value for the most recent prostate-specific antigen measurement in nanograms per milliliter.
when_unknown: Set to null if the most recent value of prostate-specific antigen in nanograms per milliliter is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the most recent measured value of the patient's prostate-specific antigen in nanograms per milliliter.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_carcinoma_of_prostate_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of prostate cancer.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of prostate cancer.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of prostate cancer.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of prostate cancer.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_carcinoma_of_prostate_now@@known
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current diagnosis of prostate cancer is known (confirmed).
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of prostate cancer and this diagnosis is known (confirmed, not suspected or unknown).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has a diagnosis of prostate cancer but it is not known (e.g., only suspected or unknown).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the diagnosis of prostate cancer is known.

name: patient_can_undergo_magnetic_resonance_imaging_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient can currently undergo magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).
when_true: Set to true if the patient can currently undergo magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), i.e., has no contraindications to MRI.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently cannot undergo magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) due to contraindications.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient can currently undergo magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).

name: patient_can_undergo_biopsy_of_prostate_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient can currently undergo a biopsy of the prostate (i.e., has no contraindications to prostate biopsy).
when_true: Set to true if the patient can currently undergo a biopsy of the prostate (i.e., there are no contraindications to prostate biopsy).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently cannot undergo a biopsy of the prostate due to contraindications.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient can currently undergo a biopsy of the prostate.
